label: chores
vignette: Consider Paji and Tudo, who live in the same house. Two tasks need to be done each week: taking out the jats and feeding the feps. They agree that the two tasks are equal in effort and value.
both_alternate: They take turns taking out the jats, and take turns feeding the feps.
bundled: Paji always takes out the jats, and Tudo always feeds the feps.
one_does_all: Paji always takes out the jats and feeds the feps.
